title: Oral archives
bodyMd: A historian interviews former dockworkers about the closure of a shipyard. Their accounts disagree on the date of a protest, but consistently describe a feeling that decisions were made elsewhere. The historian checks newspapers for the date while preserving the disagreement in the archive. She argues that the interviews reveal experiences and later interpretations, even when they cannot establish a precise chronology.
